# dsh-rtl-chat
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client plugin that makes the **conversation answer area read right-to-left
(RTL)** for Arabic, with a one-click button to switch back to left-to-right (LTR).
يعرض منطقة إجابات المحادثة في DeepSeek Harness من اليمين إلى اليسار لقراءة العربية بشكل صحيح، مع زر
للتبديل إلى الاتجاه العادي.
## Behavior / السلوك
- Only the message/answer scroll area of the conversation panel becomes RTL — the header, sidebar, a

nd app chrome stay LTR.
يُطبَّق الاتجاه على منطقة الرسائل فقط؛ الترويسة والشريط الجانبي تبقى كما هي.

- Code blocks (`pre`/`code`) inside answers stay LTR so code remains readable.
- A pill button (◄►
**RTL**/**LTR**) appears in the conversation header. Clicking it toggles the direction; your choice

is persisted in `localStorage` and survives reloads.
زر دائري في ترويسة المحادثة يبدّل الاتجاه، ويُح
فظ اختيارك تلقائيًا.
## How it works / آلية العمل
- Registers a toggle button into the live slot `conversation.header.leading` via `ctx.slots.inject`

(client-only; no agent tool involved).
- Applies a scoped stylesheet (`[data-conversation-scroll]{di
rection:rtl}` + LTR guards for code) through the package-owned `styles.insert`, inserted/removed on

toggle.
- Uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens; no imports from Harness client packages.
## Install / التثبيت
Requires a DSH web client (profile with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`) where the conversation slot tree
web client (profile with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`) where the conversation slot tree is available.

1. Copy this folder anywhere on disk, e.g. `D:\plugins\dsh-rtl-chat`.
2. In a DSH agent session, ask
it to install the bundle:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
or manually: add `"@local/dsh-rtl-chat": "link:<absolute path>"` to the profile's `package.json` dep

endencies **and** to `dsh.profile.bundles`, then run `pnpm install` in the profile directory.
3. Ref
resh the Web UI once. The button appears in the conversation header and RTL is on by default.
> Note: replacing an already-installed copy of this package requires a DSH server restart; new insta
an already-installed copy of this package requires a DSH server restart; new installs activate live.

| `package.json` | Bundle manifest (client half, web platform, injects into the conversation UI) |

`cordis.patch.yml` | Loader row that inserts this bundle into a profile composition |
| `index.js`

| Host half (no-op; all state lives in the client module) |

on, direction state, scoped RTL styles |

/en.json`, `locale/ar.json` | Display metadata (title/description) |
